name: Lumen
tagline: Turn your own notes into recall.
open: So why does so little stick?

free: Try every app before you pay

end.before: 7 days free, then £29.99 for your first year. Founding price until 31 Jan 2027.

beats.say: You highlighted everything. Every page is yellow. You read it twice. So why, when the exam asks, does so little stick?
Three hundred pages. Four days left. Where do you even start?
Breathe. Reading is not remembering. Recall is. Lumen has you.

beats.title: Bring it in
beats.say: Add a PDF or photos of your own notes. Lecture notes, handouts and books live in one calm library. Everything stays private, on your device.

beats.title: Read
beats.say: Read beside your tools. Highlight, write, add sticky notes and mark a region, right on the page. A lens follows your pointer when you need to read closely.

beats.title: Explain
beats.say: Then the real learning. Hide the page. Explain it from memory. Reveal it, and compare. Think first, then reveal, with active recall and explain it back.

beats.title: Remember
beats.say: Turn a moment into a recall card. Review timing adapts to how well you knew it. Your cards and practice lab wait for you in the study studio.

beats.title: Connect
beats.say: Every highlight and note is gathered and searchable. Drag clinical stickers onto the page, and look up words with help in many languages, including Arabic.

beats.title: Focus
beats.say: Twenty five minutes, one clear goal, soft sounds and short breaks. Daylight or evening, warm pages and your text size. Make yourself comfortable.
A five step learning loop. Six study methods. Zero automatic uploads.
Lumen is free to start. The full app comes with the Crown Pass, with seven days free. Turn your own notes into recall.
